name: DS Cluster D14: Multi-Source Composition
description: Tests: primary + reference + FRED combined. The core multi-source pattern for research studies.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D14: Multi-Source Composition
# =============================================================================
# Pattern: primary asset + reference stock + index + FRED indicator

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)

# === REFERENCE STOCK (benchmark) ===
spy = common_reference_stocks(ticker=ReferenceStock.SPY)()
spy_rets = returns(spy.c)

# === INDEX (VIX for regime) ===
vix = common_indices(ticker=ReferenceIndex.VIX)()
vix_level = vix.c
high_vol = vix_level > 20

# === FRED (yield curve for macro regime) ===
spread_10y = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y)()
spread_2y = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury2Y)()
yield_curve = ffill(spread_10y.result) - ffill(spread_2y.result)
curve_inverted = yield_curve < 0

# === RELATIVE STRENGTH ===
alpha = rets - spy_rets
alpha_cum = cumulative()(alpha)

# === REGIME-CONDITIONED RETURNS ===
high_vol_rets = where(high_vol, rets)
normal_vol_rets = where(high_vol == False, rets)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="AAPL vs SPY (Cumulative Alpha)",
    category="Multi-Source",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Alpha", color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Flat")])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=alpha_cum)

xy_lines(
    title="VIX + Yield Curve",
    category="Multi-Source",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="VIX", color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="10Y-2Y Spread", color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(vix_level, yield_curve))

histogram(
    title="Returns: High Vol vs Normal",
    category="Multi-Source",
    bins=30
)(high_vol_rets)
